api:
OV.Morale.lossPct(B, u) → % of morale losses applied (TUNE.MORALE_LOSS_PCT[difficulty] for origSide 'xcom', else 100). Morale.onHit / onDeath now scale X-COM losses by it. Morale.panicPhase skips an X-COM unit whose last episode is ≤ TUNE.PANIC_COOLDOWN_TURNS[diff] turns old; this consumes no RNG. New unit field u.panicTurn (turn of the last episode). Each X-COM episode adds 1 to B.stats.xcomPanics (initial 0).
OV.Battle.outcome(B) returns 'win' when objectiveDestroyed(B) on kind 'cydonia' OR 'alienBase'.
OV.Battle.debrief(B, ctx) result gains two fields:
- objective: bool. True for a win by objective while aliens still stand. Those aliens are neither killed nor captured, and the items they hold are not recovered.
- panics: int, equal to B.stats.xcomPanics.
OV.Battle.quickLoadout(month, night) by month:
- 0: rifle + coveralls
- 1–2: laser_rifle + personal_armour
- 3–5: heavy_plasma (2 clips) + personal_armour
- 6+: heavy_plasma + power_suit
OV.Campaign.assaultForce(G, ufo) → int. Expected crew strength of the UFO: Σ avg qty × (tu + fire + hp + front armour) for the race and difficulty, with crewDifficulty for the month, × (100 + TUNE.BASE_DEFENCE_TIER_PCT × expected weapon tier)/100.
OV.Campaign.defenderPower(soldier) → tu + fire + hp + front armour of the worn suit.
OV.Campaign.baseDefence(G, baseId, ufoId): same signature, new rule:
- need = floor(assaultForce × BASE_DEFENCE_CREW_PCT/100) × hull left / hp
- strength = Σ defenderPower + min(Σ power × FACILITY_PCT/100, men × FACILITY_CAP_PCT/100)
- dead on a win = clamp(round(garrison × need/strength × CASUALTY_PCT/100), 1, garrison)
OV.Campaign.finishMission(G, B) model gains surrendered: {unitType:n}. That bag is the alien-base surrender, capped per rank by the B.crew count minus those captured in battle, and it is also included in capturedStored.
TUNE changes:
- New: MORALE_LOSS_PCT [50,100,100], PANIC_COOLDOWN_TURNS [1,0,0], BASE_DEFENCE_CREW_PCT 50, BASE_DEFENCE_TIER_PCT 20, BASE_DEFENCE_FACILITY_CAP_PCT 66, BASE_DEFENCE_CASUALTY_PCT 40.
- Changed: BASE_DEFENCE_FACILITY_PCT 100 → 25.
- Removed: BASE_DEFENCE_BASE and BASE_DEFENCE_PER_COEF.
summary:
All 5 findings in r4_fixS.json are fixed at the root; none were skipped. Each has a regression check in tools/tests/sim_persona_r4.test.js (8 tests, about 2 s).

The full suite (node tools/test.js --strict --i18n) has 778 passing and 1 failing. The failure is in ui_persona_r3.test.js and comes from js/gfx/battle_render.js, which another fixer is editing right now (see open_issues). The only missing i18n key is `nao.existe.x`, which a test uses on purpose.

The QA run qa/full_campaign.mjs (1440×900) passed with exit 0, 0 confusing moments and the debrief screen looking normal (screenshots in scratchpad/ui4/persona_r4_sim/). I changed no screens.

**Finding 0 — chain panic on Recruta: fixed.**
- Root cause: morale loss from wounds and comrade deaths had no difficulty factor.
- On Recruta, X-COM morale losses are now halved (MORALE_LOSS_PCT [50,100,100]). A soldier who panics or goes berserk can't panic again on the next X-COM turn (PANIC_COOLDOWN_TURNS [1,0,0]). Veterano and Super-humano keep the original rules.
- Measured with 10 rank-0 Bravery-10 rookies, 3 deaths plus hits, then 3 panic phases, 40 seeds: 2.23 panic episodes on average (max 6) before, 0 after.
- With the novice bot on Recruta, panic/berserk per battle fell from 0.50 to 0.08 on terror and from 0.33 to 0 on a landed Large Scout.
- Each X-COM panic episode is now counted (`B.stats.xcomPanics`, `debrief.panics`) so the debrief can explain it. The debrief tip itself is UI work; the patch is in open_issues.

**Finding 1 — base defence trivial: fixed.**
- What the garrison must beat now depends on the attacking UFO's crew: race, difficulty, and the month's alien weapon level.
- Soldier strength now includes worn armour.
- Defence facilities still fire at the hull first. After that they add only 25 % of their power, capped at 66 % of the soldiers' strength, so at least 60 % has to come from soldiers.
- Soldiers killed in a won defence now scale with how close the fight was, instead of a random 1–3.
- Re-running the persona's script on 40 seeds (Veterano and Super-humano): 1 soldier + 2–3 Missile Defences went from 40/40 repelled to 0/40 against a Battleship. Against a Terror Ship with 3 defences, 2/40 hold, because the defences' volley nearly shot it down.
- On Veterano in month 3, the 10 starting rookies hold against Sectoids (about 3.5 killed) but lose to Mutons.
- Campaign bot: Veterano 5/5 attacks repelled, Super-humano 11/11, no base lost (the bot brings the squad home after the warning).
- Soldiers away on a craft still don't defend, as in the original. This is now documented in DESIGN §22. The payoff of hiding veterans is gone, because one recruit plus defences now loses the base.

**Finding 2 — alien-base control centre does nothing: fixed with option (a).**
- Destroying it now wins the mission, same as Cydonia, so the briefing text is true.
- Aliens still standing are not counted as kills or captures, and what they hold is not recovered. This stops it being a way to grab loot without fighting.
- The existing +500 «Base alienígena destruída» line and the surrender still apply.

**Finding 3 — surrender incoherent: fixed.**
- At most as many of each rank surrender as the battle crew had (Veterano: 1 commander + 1 leader; Super-humano: 1 + 2), minus those already captured in the battle.
- The finishMission result now lists them separately (`model.surrendered`) so the debrief can show «renderam-se» on its own line. That line is UI work; the patch is in open_issues.
- One commander is enough for the whole story chain, so Cydonia is still reachable.

**Finding 4 — balance tool shows a false month-2 wall: fixed.**
- Battle.quickLoadout now follows the bot's real gear over the campaign (sampled on Veterano, seeds 1–3): month 0 rifle; months 1–2 Laser Rifle + Personal Armour; months 3–5 Heavy Plasma + Personal Armour; month 6+ Heavy Plasma + Power Suit. The tools/sim.js header documents this.
- Month-2 sweep (8 seeds, --vet): terror 13 → 63 %, alien base 13 → 63 %, Abductor 50 → 100 %. The campaign bot itself wins about 92 %, 73 % and 99 %.

**Other checks**
- Veterano campaign, 6 seeds: 3 wins, 2 Cydonia losses, 1 timeout (before: 4, 1, 1). The only change is seed 3, whose Cydonia battle went differently because earlier random draws shifted; the council failed no campaign.
- A Recruta save/load determinism check (`--det --save-mid`) exited 0.
- I updated other areas' tests in tools/tests that pinned the old rules: battle_morale/battle_combat now run at Veterano difficulty; battle_core, campaign_flow, campaign_pacing and geo_wave4fix check the new values.
- Docs: CAMPAIGN_API §5.9 and the finishMission model, the §8 tuning table, a new §11.11 with all the numbers, and a new persona round 4 block in DESIGN §22.
deviations: Alien base: destroying the control centre ends the battle at once as a win, matching the briefing. As far as I recall OpenXcom lets the battle continue and only counts an abort after it as a success. Documented in DESIGN §22 and CAMPAIGN_API §11.11.

Base defence: soldiers away on an airborne craft still do not count, for strength or for losses, as in the original. The finding proposed counting them. The new rule (most of the strength must come from soldiers, losses grow with how close the fight was) already removes the payoff of leaving 1 recruit plus defences, so I documented it as deliberate rather than tracking take-off times.
A soldier's strength in base defence now includes the front armour of the suit they wear, to match the aliens' side. The garrison-strength tests changed accordingly.

The debrief has no new «Centro de controlo destruído» points line, because the sim cannot add i18n keys. The win uses the existing «Base alienígena destruída» +500 line plus the new `debrief.objective` flag. A UI patch for a note is in open_issues.
Morale scaling on Recruta covers onHit and onDeath, including the friendly-kill and civilian-kill penalties. It does not cover fatal-wound ticks or psionic panic.
